Voice contract for check_writing 4: Agents 101 trio, because APT101 sits on the A101 spine and the audience is a product trio; the template's voice list does not name APT101. Rule question for the maintainer on check_student_facing 31: the widened clause names 'just say go' as a catch while seven sibling exercises ship 'then say "continue"' unchanged; judged as house convention, not filed. Cross-class observations (not rows): the body says 'score' at L59 while the shared eval-loop fences count flagged claims, so 'score dropped' can read as 'got worse' (suggestion given; pedagogy/technical may own it); curriculum/CLAUDE.md points at check_student_facing 2 for the room-acknowledging tells and the one-line-per-file ceiling, but the brief's section 2 text carries neither, so L65 'says your missing line out loud' (an out-loud share at a group beat) was judged as a group beat and not against a rule the compendium text does not hold.
